ask.title.purpose: Heading of the one-time question about update checks.

ask.help.purpose: Says what an update check sends (the app's version) and to whom, and that nothing is downloaded.

settings.panel.purpose: Heading of the Settings panel for switches that contact online services.

settings.label.purpose: Label of the update checks switch.

settings.help.purpose: What an update check sends and how often; that it only tells.

settings.error.purpose: The switch could not be saved.

settings.checkNow.purpose: Button: check for a newer version right now.
settings.checkNow.where: Settings, under the switch while on.

settings.upToDate.purpose: No newer version, and when the last check ran.

settings.newer.purpose: A newer version was found; points to About.

about.available.where: Settings, About panel, under the version.

about.linkLabel.purpose: Label for the release page address, shown as text to copy (the app opens no links).

about.copy.purpose: Button: copy the release page address.

about.copyFailed.purpose: The copy did not work; tells the user to copy by hand.

notice.line.where: Overview, a short line near the top.

notice.open.purpose: Link to Settings, where the address to copy is.
